psychological_meaning: Fruit Salad, as a color, evokes feelings of freshness, health, and vitality. Its blend of green and yellow suggests growth, optimism, and a connection to nature. It often creates a sense of balance and harmony, promoting feelings of well-being and rejuvenation.
